title: LM2596 buck converter
prompt: an LM2596 buck converter module between a battery and a robot: connect the battery, turn the trimpot to set 5.0 V or 3.3 V, try for 12 V, then stall the motor and watch a brown-out; see-through labels the regulator chip, inductor, diode, capacitors and trimpot
blurb: Set a robot's supply voltage and overload a buck converter in an illustrative battery-and-motor teaching model.
teachingAdaptations: 7.4 V example battery, illustrative voltage sag and 2 A continuous module budget, wide-supply robot electronics, slowed switching depiction; not a calibrated circuit simulation.
